A follow-up could add a test that mutates the imported `buckMachine` graph, restores it in `afterEach`, and verifies the pre-change routing against the live source — making the rollback's behavior identical to the legacy assertion. This is a test-quality concern; production behavior is unaffected. ### 2. Documented in the type docstring. The `rankPending` function and the machine-test cases exercise the route when the verdict is absent. ## Out of scope / not re-reviewed - Raw transcript totals for the SQL save smoke and the Grok provider smoke - Skill/command micro-readability - Documentation coverage for every updated paragraph - The new Astro site's full build output - Phased plan boundary semantics beyond what the iteration artifacts document ## Summary This is a substantial, well-tested change. The two minor items do not affect the production contract.
